date: 14th Day of the Harvest Moon, Year 682 After Baronies Founding
title: The monster of the Lowshanks
author: Boon J. Cobson
preview: As we all know the druidic circles are a popular place for the youth of the town to go to, where they play tricks and do their nightly parties. Who among us has not gone there when young with stolen wine or even more? He who is innocent cast the first stone. But ...
content:
Our local heroes have struck again! This time they have ventured into the Lowshanks caverns, a place that has been the source of many rumors and stories. The caverns are as we all know the home of the Lowshanks and a location that speaks to rumours and gossip of all kinds. A place of mystery as very few of us have ever been to their headquarters. As we all know the Lowshanks are a group of bandits that have been enacting a toll on the road that leads to the city of Snakefat. They have been a thorn in the side of the town for a long time, a thorn that we all tolerated for the benefits it brought on the monsters that dwell the forests.

Alas, for the Lowshanks, karma caught up with them. The druidic stones had one last horror in store, sadly the Lowshanks were not prepared for it. The monstrosity that came for the Lowshanks was a horrible mutated rat creature, sharp teeth, claws and a long tail. Bald, sores, and disease riddled, from sources that were there we heard that it was a nightmare came to life.

Sadly, none of the Lowshanks survived their encounter with the creature, and when our Local Snakefat Four went to investigate the Lowshanks lair they found the bodies of the bandits, and the horrible being was engorging itself on their bodies. Those not completely eviscerated were bound in an undead state, and became a zombie-like being. In a fight for their lives the Snakefat Four, defeated the monster. The creature was a formidable opponent, and it took all of their skills and teamwork to defeat it.

Our heroes came back, with another threat to the town vanquished, and a new story to tell. With the rat monster defeated the last bit of dark threat from the Druidic Circle is now gone (hopefully). With the Lowshanks gone the road to Snakefat is now toll free. Time will tell if prosperity will improve without our local highway gang, or if the monsters that lurk in the woods will now be more of a problem without the bandits to keep them at bay.
